sharedPrompt.format: One full-bleed illustration that fills the whole image edge to edge. Flat 2D illustration, no 3D rendering, no photorealism.
sharedPrompt.artStyle: Warm, cosy flat 2D storybook illustration, like a mural on a fantasy tavern wall: confident brown-black ink outlines, flat colour with soft hard-edged shading, lantern and candle light pooling on wood and brass, and shelves crammed with clutter drawn in loving detail. Characters are expressive fantasy shopkeepers of every kind (dwarves, elves, goblins, orcs, halflings, witches, lizardfolk, ghosts and stranger things) shown at their counter, stall or forge, each with a strong silhouette and a knowing face. Palette: warm amber, deep burgundy, aged parchment, dark oak brown and polished brass, with cool teal-blue shadows for depth. A fine paper-grain texture over everything. Overall mood: cosy, bustling and sly, like a market street where everyone has a deal for you.
frame: Border: a thick border of carved dark oak, like the frame of an old shop sign, with a shallow bevel, small carved vine scrolls along its length and polished brass corner fittings with visible screw heads.
Top-left corner: a small round set emblem of a plump brown leather coin purse with a brass clasp and three gold coins spilling from it, with no letters.

Top: an empty name banner shaped like a long rectangular brass nameplate with rounded ends and a brass rivet at each end, with a pale cream-brass inner panel, about 10% of the card height, with no letters in it.

Bottom: a pale parchment text panel below the window, about 30% of the card height, like a page from a shop ledger, with a thin burgundy edge and faint ruled lines. The top third of the panel is empty space for two lines of flavour text. A thin burgundy divider line runs across the panel below that space.

Stats grid: the lower two-thirds of the panel is split into two rows by a thin burgundy divider. The top row is split into three equal cells and the bottom row into two equal wider cells, by thin vertical burgundy dividers. All five cells are pale parchment. Each cell has one small bold icon on its left side, no wider than a quarter of the cell, and the rest of the cell to the right is empty space for a word like 'HAGGLING' and a large number. The icons, top row left to right: a pair of brass balance scales; a stacked wooden crate with a sack on top; a cut red gem sparkling. Bottom row left to right: a single narrowed eye peering out from under a dark hood; a frothy wooden tankard. The icons are simple, flat and bold, in brass, burgundy, dark oak and amber.

Card number: below the panel, on the border, in the bottom-right corner only, one wide empty dark oak plaque with a brass edge for the card number, about 22% of the card width, so it can hold text like '#30 of 30'. The bottom-left corner has no badge, only border. The plaque is empty, with no letters.
Accent colours on the frame are only dark oak brown, brass gold, burgundy, amber and parchment cream. Do not use pink, magenta or hot pink anywhere on the frame.
sharedPrompt.negative: No 3D render, no CGI, no photorealism, no anime style, no gore, no blood, no real people, no real brands or logos, no real or existing cartoon, game or film characters, no watermark, no text, no signature, no readable writing on signs or labels.

rulesCard.title: How to Play
steps: Two players. Deal all the cards evenly.
Each player shuffles their cards into a face-down deck.
Each player turns over their top card and looks at it.
The winner of the last round picks a stat. In the first round, the player who most recently bought something picks.
Reveal the cards. The higher value in the called stat wins.
The winner keeps both cards in their own pile. On a tie, each player keeps their own card.
When your deck runs out, shuffle your pile to make a new deck.
You win when your opponent has no cards left. Thank you for your custom!
rulesCard.framePrompt: The front of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in the same warm cosy flat 2D storybook style. The same thick carved dark oak border with small carved vine scrolls and polished brass corner fittings with screw heads. The same round emblem in the top-left corner: a plump brown leather coin purse with a brass clasp and three gold coins spilling from it. The same empty long brass nameplate with rounded ends and a brass rivet at each end along the top, with a pale cream-brass inner panel. Below the nameplate, filling the rest of the card down to the border, one large empty panel in even pale parchment with a thin burgundy edge, with no ruled lines, icons, dividers or badges. No text, letters or numbers anywhere. Do not use pink or magenta.

cards.name: Durnik Ironbelly
cards.character: A broad, barrel-chested dwarf smith with a soot-streaked red beard tied in brass rings, a scorched leather apron and forearms like hams, holding a gleaming new sword up to the light.
cards.poseAndExpression: Squinting critically down the blade with one eye closed, lips pursed, not yet satisfied.
cards.backgroundScene: A glowing forge behind him with racks of hammers, tongs and finished blades on the stone wall, sparks drifting in the air.
cards.flavourText: Won't sell a blade he wouldn't swing himself.

cards.name: Grizelda's Potion Seconds
cards.character: A wiry old witch with wild grey hair under a crumpled hat and spectacles on a chain, behind a trestle table crowded with mismatched bottles in every colour, some fizzing, one gently smoking.
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding up a cloudy green bottle with a hopeful grin, the other hand already palm-up for the coins.
cards.backgroundScene: A damp market corner under a dripping awning, with a hand-painted sign shape above and a cat asleep among the bottles.
cards.flavourText: The labels fell off, but the prices are very good.

cards.name: The No-Refunds Mimic
cards.character: A huge treasure chest with a wide toothy mouth and a long purple tongue, wearing a tiny green visor, sitting behind a pawn-shop counter heaped with swords, lutes and a single boot.
cards.poseAndExpression: Grinning with every tooth showing, tongue lolling, one wooden lid-corner raised like an eyebrow.
cards.backgroundScene: A cramped pawn shop with shelves of pledged goods, hanging lanterns and a row of little brass bells over the door.
cards.flavourText: Every sale is final and so, usually, is the customer.

cards.name: Madame Vellamour
cards.character: A tall, elegant elf in flowing layered silks of burgundy and gold, with silver hair piled high and long jewelled fingers, standing among bolts of shimmering fabric.
cards.poseAndExpression: Draping a length of silk over one arm and gazing at the viewer with a slow, knowing smile.
cards.backgroundScene: A luxurious draper's shop with fabric cascading from high shelves, a tall mirror and candlelight glinting on gold thread.
cards.flavourText: Nothing in this shop has ever been cheap, including the compliments.

cards.name: Old Pip
cards.character: A round little halfling with a bald head, enormous white eyebrows and a magnifying glass on a cord, surrounded by rolled parchment maps spilling from every pocket and shelf.
cards.poseAndExpression: Unrolling a map across the counter and pointing at it with great confidence and a cheerful, toothless grin.
cards.backgroundScene: A tiny cluttered shop lined with map tubes, a globe missing a continent and a stuffed owl wearing a compass.
cards.flavourText: His maps will get you somewhere, which is more than most.

cards.name: Bram Stoutkeg
cards.character: A mountainous orc innkeeper with a shaved green head, a magnificent tusked grin and a stained apron, carrying four foaming tankards in each enormous hand.
cards.poseAndExpression: Laughing heartily with his head thrown back, foam sloshing over the tankards.
cards.backgroundScene: A warm, crowded tavern with a roaring hearth, barrels stacked to the rafters and a fiddler on a table in the background.
cards.flavourText: There's always another barrel in the cellar, and he fetches it himself.

cards.name: Sister Marigold
cards.character: A gentle, plump human priestess in cream and amber robes with a sunflower embroidered on the front, standing behind a small altar-counter of holy water phials and little wax blessings.
cards.poseAndExpression: Smiling warmly with her hands folded, head tilted in patient kindness.
cards.backgroundScene: A sunlit temple alcove with stained glass, candles in rows and a sleeping dog curled at the foot of the altar.
cards.flavourText: Her blessings work beautifully and she will not be haggled down.

cards.name: Fenwick Thimble
cards.character: A tiny gnome with enormous brass goggles, a frizz of white hair and a dozen tools strapped to a bandolier, perched on a stool behind a counter of whirring, ticking contraptions.
cards.poseAndExpression: Winding a clockwork bird with a screwdriver, tongue poking out in concentration, a spring boinging loose beside him.
cards.backgroundScene: A workshop-shop packed with gears, bellows, dangling springs and shelves of half-finished inventions, one of them smoking slightly.
cards.flavourText: Every gadget does something, though rarely what the label says.

cards.name: Mother Ashgrave
cards.character: A faintly translucent ghost of an elderly woman in a high-collared Victorian-style dress, floating behind the counter of a bookshop with a stack of books hovering beside her.
cards.poseAndExpression: Peering over half-moon spectacles with a disapproving but fond expression, one finger raised to her lips for quiet.
cards.backgroundScene: A tall, narrow haunted bookshop with ladders, cobwebbed shelves rising into darkness and a single candle on the counter.
cards.flavourText: Returns are accepted at midnight and nobody has ever tried twice.

cards.name: Skrix
cards.character: A skinny goblin in an oversized patched coat with the lining full of dangling watches, rings and daggers, lurking behind an upturned crate in an alley.
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding his coat open with both hands and a sly, gap-toothed grin, eyes darting sideways.
cards.backgroundScene: A narrow rain-slick alley at night with a single lantern, a cat on a barrel and the shadow of a town guard at the far end.
cards.flavourText: Everything he sells came from somewhere, and that's all you'll get out of him.

cards.name: Aunt Bessamy
cards.character: A rosy-cheeked halfling baker with flour on her nose, curly hair in a kerchief and a tray of golden pies held proudly in oven mitts.
cards.poseAndExpression: Beaming with pride and offering the tray forward, one pie already missing a slice.
cards.backgroundScene: A cosy bakery with loaves on cooling racks, a brick oven glowing behind and steam fogging the little window.
cards.flavourText: Nobody leaves her counter hungry or with their coins.

cards.name: Vorlag the Armourer
cards.character: A hulking grey-skinned orc with one tusk, a scarred face and a chainmail vest, standing beside a dented but heavy suit of plate on a stand, hammer resting on one shoulder.
cards.poseAndExpression: Arms folded, scowling down at the viewer with deep suspicion.
cards.backgroundScene: A dim armoury with racks of shields, helmets on hooks and a quenching trough steaming in the corner.
cards.flavourText: His armour will stop anything, including conversation.

cards.name: The Twins Tallow
cards.character: Two identical small kobolds in matching waxy aprons, one on the other's shoulders, surrounded by thousands of candles in every size, stacked in teetering towers.
cards.poseAndExpression: The top kobold holds a candle aloft like a torch while the bottom one grins up, both squinting in the glow.
cards.backgroundScene: A candle shop crammed floor to ceiling with candles, wax drips everywhere and a hundred small flames reflected in a window.
cards.flavourText: Between them they have never once run out of anything.

cards.name: Cassius Gildmoor
cards.character: A sleek human jeweller with oiled black hair, a waxed moustache, a velvet waistcoat and a jeweller's loupe, presenting a ring on a cushion.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning in with a dazzling, slightly too-wide smile and one eyebrow raised in invitation.
cards.backgroundScene: A plush jeweller's shop with glass cases of glittering stones, velvet drapes and a locked iron door behind the counter.
cards.flavourText: Starts every price three times too high and still looks wounded when you argue.

cards.name: Grubb
cards.character: A squat, mossy troll with a huge underbite, a tattered apron and a single turnip in one hand, sitting at a rickety stall built onto the side of a stone bridge.
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding out the turnip in one hand and his other palm up for payment, with a slow, stubborn frown.
cards.backgroundScene: A stone bridge over a misty river, with a rough stall of planks, a pile of turnips and a hand-painted toll sign shape.
cards.flavourText: Sells turnips, charges a toll, and won't say which you're paying for.

cards.name: Ysolde Nightwick
cards.character: A striking tiefling with curling horns hung with tiny charms, violet skin and layers of shawls and beads, seated at a small round table of crystals, cards and amulets.
cards.poseAndExpression: Fanning out a hand of cards with a mysterious, amused half-smile, eyes glowing faintly.
cards.backgroundScene: A dim tent lined with hanging charms, a crystal ball glowing on the table and incense smoke curling upward.
cards.flavourText: Every charm she sells is guaranteed, though she never says against what.

cards.name: Barnaby Crowe
cards.character: A lanky scarecrow with a sackcloth face, button eyes and a straw-stuffed waistcoat, standing behind a farm stall heaped with pumpkins, apples and bunches of carrots.
cards.poseAndExpression: Proudly presenting a giant pumpkin with both stick-arms, head tilted in a crooked, friendly grin.
cards.backgroundScene: A sunny harvest market with hay bales, crates of produce and a crow perched on the stall, eating an apple.
cards.flavourText: Grows it all himself and the crows get first pick.

cards.name: Lady Pemberton-Quill
cards.character: A severe, slender elf with a tight silver bun, pince-nez and an immaculate high-collared gown, standing before shelves of pristine inks, quills and heavy cream paper.
cards.poseAndExpression: Looking down her nose at the viewer, holding a single perfect quill between two fingers.
cards.backgroundScene: A spotless, hushed stationer's shop with glass cabinets of ink bottles arranged by colour and a brass pen rack.
cards.flavourText: Her paper is flawless and so, she will remind you, is her opinion.

cards.name: Big Hilde
cards.character: A cheerful giantess with blonde braids, rolled sleeves and a huge striped apron, ducking under the beams of a general store, holding a sack of flour the size of a pony in one hand.
cards.poseAndExpression: Grinning down at the viewer with a wave, half her head out of frame among the rafters.
cards.backgroundScene: A general store with shelves to the ceiling full of pots, rope, boots and jars, with a tiny ladder leaning against them.
cards.flavourText: Keeps the whole village stocked and reaches the top shelf without a ladder.

cards.name: Nib & Nub
cards.character: Two plump rats in tiny waistcoats standing on their hind legs behind a cheese counter, one holding a wedge of cheese, the other holding a very small set of scales.
cards.poseAndExpression: Both squinting shrewdly at the viewer, whiskers twitching, the scales very obviously tipped.
cards.backgroundScene: A cheese shop with great wheels of cheese on shelves, a cat-shaped silhouette in the window and crumbs everywhere.
cards.flavourText: Two sets of eyes on the scales and both of them cheating.

cards.name: Thorvald Saltbeard
cards.character: A weathered dwarf fishmonger with a salt-crusted white beard, a sou'wester hat and a gleaming cleaver, standing before a slab of fish on ice that has mostly melted.
cards.poseAndExpression: Holding up a slightly limp fish by the tail with a huge, proud grin, blissfully unaware of the smell.
cards.backgroundScene: A harbour-side fish stall with gulls circling, nets drying and boats bobbing behind in the morning light.
cards.flavourText: Fresh in this morning, he says, and has said every morning this week.

cards.name: The Librarian Lich
cards.character: A gaunt skeletal lich in tattered scholar's robes with a glowing blue light in each eye socket, standing behind a lectern-counter stacked with ancient chained tomes.
cards.poseAndExpression: Pressing one bony finger to the cover of a book and fixing the viewer with a slow, unblinking stare.
cards.backgroundScene: A vaulted crypt-library with endless shelves, floating candles and dust motes glowing in shafts of cold light.
cards.flavourText: First editions only, and he was there for most of them.

cards.name: Pennyroyal
cards.character: A tiny glowing fairy with dragonfly wings and a dress of sugar-pink petals replaced by warm amber petals, hovering over a stall of jars of sweets, lollipops and sugared violets.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sitting on the rim of a sweet jar, swinging her legs and holding out a lollipop bigger than her head with a delighted smile.
cards.backgroundScene: A sweet shop with rows of glass jars in every colour, striped paper bags and a brass scoop on the counter.
cards.flavourText: One free sample and you'll be back every day for a year.

cards.name: Hob Underbough
cards.character: A shaggy hedge druid with a beard full of twigs, antlers wound with ivy and a cloak of leaves, standing behind a stall of bundled herbs, mushrooms and clay pots of seedlings.
cards.poseAndExpression: Sniffing a bunch of herbs with his eyes closed and a contented, faraway smile.
cards.backgroundScene: A forest-edge market stall under a great oak, with drying herbs hanging overhead and a hedgehog among the pots.
cards.flavourText: Grows a cure for everything and has forgotten which one is which.

cards.name: Marrok the Moonlit
cards.character: A shaggy grey werewolf in a torn merchant's doublet, standing behind a cart of daggers, crossbows and traps, with a sign shape flipped to show it is open.
cards.poseAndExpression: Leaning on the cart with one clawed hand and a toothy grin, ears pricked, glancing up at the moon.
cards.backgroundScene: A moonlit crossroads at night with the weapons cart, a lantern on a pole and a distant village with its windows shuttered.
cards.flavourText: Open after dark only, and he'd rather you didn't ask why.

cards.name: Dame Agatha Pryce
cards.character: A formidable elderly human woman with a towering grey wig, a lorgnette and a black gown, standing at an auctioneer's podium with a small ivory gavel raised.
cards.poseAndExpression: Gavel raised mid-strike, mouth open in a sharp call, eyes gleaming with the thrill of a bid.
cards.backgroundScene: A grand auction hall with a chandelier, rows of raised paddles and a painting on an easel beside the podium.
cards.flavourText: Going once, going twice, and somehow you've bought it.

cards.name: Snorri Two-Hats
cards.character: A scruffy kobold wearing two hats stacked on top of each other, with a third in each hand, standing behind a hat stall where every hat looks suspiciously similar.
cards.poseAndExpression: Offering both hats forward with an eager, shifty grin, eyes flicking between them.
cards.backgroundScene: A cluttered hat stall under a striped awning, with hat boxes stacked high and a mirror that has clearly been cracked and glued.
cards.flavourText: Sold the same hat to the same knight three times.

cards.name: Ol' Glimmer
cards.character: A small copper dragon wyrmling with tiny spectacles perched on its snout, curled protectively around a stall of trinkets, goblets and coins that are clearly from its own hoard.
cards.poseAndExpression: Clutching a single gold goblet to its chest with both claws, eyes narrowed, lips curled back from its teeth in a reluctant snarl.
cards.backgroundScene: A cave-mouth stall with a glittering mound of treasure behind and a few pieces set out on a velvet cloth, very reluctantly.
cards.flavourText: Technically for sale, though no one has ever managed to buy anything.

cards.name: Captain Mireille
cards.character: A dashing sea-elf with sea-green hair in a long braid, a tricorn hat and a salt-stained coat, leaning on a crate marked only with a strange stamp, at a dockside stall of exotic goods.
cards.poseAndExpression: Tipping her hat with a wink and a crooked smile, one boot up on the crate.
cards.backgroundScene: A foggy dock at dusk with a moored ship, crates and barrels stacked high and a lantern swinging from a hook.
cards.flavourText: Imports, she calls them, and the harbour master calls them something else.

cards.name: Grandmother Oakhollow
cards.character: An ancient, gentle treant with a face in her bark, moss for hair and birds nesting in her branches, pouring tea from a huge kettle at a stall built around her own trunk.
cards.poseAndExpression: Smiling warmly with crinkled bark eyes, pouring tea into a line of mismatched cups.
cards.backgroundScene: The heart of the market square at golden hour, with stalls all around her, lanterns in her branches and villagers gathered on benches at her roots.
cards.flavourText: Every deal in the market is shaken on over one of her cups of tea.

cardBack.prompt: The back of one vertical trading card, seen flat and straight on, filling the whole image edge to edge, in a warm cosy flat 2D storybook style with confident brown-black ink outlines, flat colour, soft hard-edged shading and a fine paper-grain texture. A design mirrored top to bottom, so it looks the same either way up, with no single upright object in the middle: a thick carved dark oak border with small carved vine scrolls and polished brass corner fittings with screw heads, around a deep burgundy centre panel with a faint damask pattern. In the exact centre, a round brass medallion holding a plump brown leather coin purse lying on its side, with gold coins spilling out of it to the left and the right. Above and below the medallion, mirrored brass balance scales and mirrored fans of gold coins, the lower ones upside down. Small brass keys, gems and tankards fill the rest of the panel in a loose mirrored pattern. No text, letters or numbers. Do not use pink or magenta.
